title: Shifted Hermite-Biehler Kernel Identities, Local Multiplicity Jets, and Truncated Prime-Power Multipliers for Riemann's Xi-Function
description: We establish three algebraic and analytic identities relating shifted Hermite-Biehler kernels, critical-line multiplicity jets, and holomorphic prime-power multipliers to the transverse Wronskian W(d,t) = (1/2) d_d |Xi(t-id)|^2 of Riemann's Xi-function, together with explicit circularity and domain obstructions: (1) K_alpha(t-id, t-id) = (alpha/pi)*W_tilde(d,t) and finite Cauchy-Pick divided-difference matrices, with positive semidefiniteness equivalent to the Riemann Hypothesis; (2) the order-m Jensen-Laguerre multiplicity jet c_{2m-1}(t_0) = [m/(m!)^2]*(f^{(m)}(t_0))^2 > 0 and local quadratic bowls distinguishing real Lehmer pairs from off-critical conjugate pairs; and (3) the Leibniz-Wronskian multiplier identity, bounded residual Dirichlet coefficients 0 <= b_n^E(X) <= 1 on Re(s) > 1, exact Fejer Bochner-Weil strip residue jumps, and the exact critical-line Stirling envelope identity Xi(t) = -E_0(t)Z(t).
